title: Request
description: What the intake stage writes: the job request in the requester's words, plus the defaults the producer proposed (each stated with a reason). Stored in job.outputs.request.data. The admin approves it at the intake gate.

raw_request.description: The ask exactly as given (chat text, forwarded client message, voice-note transcript). No phone numbers.

requested_by.description: Team member handle who brought the request.

occasion.description: Festival, launch or event, if any.

deliverables.description: Rough list; the brief stage makes it exact. e.g. 'Instagram reel 9:16 ~20s', 'WhatsApp status poster'.

reason.description: One line, shown at the intake gate.

chosen.description: Set when the admin approves or overrides.

credits.description: Hard cap, default from config by job type.

reason.description: Why this budget, if not the default.

assumptions.description: Every default filled in without being told (deadline, assignee, track, budget), so the admin can correct it.
